connection_condition: customers.fld002 carries the segment value on the same row as the customer identifier customers.fld001
description: Each customer belongs to one of the segments SME, LAM or KAM.

connection_condition: customers.fld003 carries the billing currency on the same row as the customer identifier
description: Each customer settles in one billing currency, CZK or EUR.

connection_condition: yearmonth.fld001 corresponds to customers.fld001; every consumption row belongs to exactly one customer
description: A customer is composed of monthly consumption records; a consumption record cannot exist without its customer. 30566 of 32461 customers have at least one consumption record.

connection_condition: yearmonth.fld010 is the YYYYMM period on the same row as the consumption value
description: Each monthly consumption value is recorded for one calendar month.

connection_condition: gasstations.fld005 holds the chain number for each station; many stations share one chain
description: A chain is composed of gas stations; each station belongs to exactly one chain.

connection_condition: gasstations.fld006 carries the country code on the station row
description: Each gas station is located in one country.

connection_condition: gasstations.fld002 carries the station segment on the station row
description: Each gas station is classified into one commercial segment.

connection_condition: transactions.fld001 corresponds to customers.fld001; zero orphan transactions
description: Each transaction is made by one customer.

connection_condition: transactions.fld004 corresponds to gasstations.fld004; zero orphan transactions
description: Each transaction takes place at one gas station.

connection_condition: transactions.fld007 corresponds to products.fld007; zero orphan transactions
transactions.fld010 is the transaction date on the same row
description: Each transaction occurs on one calendar date.

connection_condition: transactions.fld011 is the clock time on the same row
description: Each transaction occurs at one clock time; date and time together form a timestamp.

connection_condition: transactions.fld014 is the total price on the same row
description: Each transaction has one total price.

connection_condition: transactions.fld013 is the quantity on the same row
description: Each transaction records the quantity of the purchased product.

connection_condition: products.fld008 carries the description on the product row
description: Each product has one textual description.

connection_condition: annual consumption aggregates the monthly consumption values of one calendar year for the same customer or group
description: Annual consumption is computed as the sum of monthly consumption over the months of a calendar year; average monthly consumption for the year divides that total by twelve.

connection_condition: growth compares the annual consumption totals of two calendar years for the same customer group
description: Consumption growth is the difference between two years' annual consumption, optionally expressed as a percentage of the base year.
